_comment: Hooks for python-plugin. PostToolUse: format the changed Python file with ruff. Tries Docker first (service 'app'), falls back to the local ruff CLI, swallows errors so it never blocks the user.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE"; case "$f" in *.py) docker compose exec -T app ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac

bash -c 's=""; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh" ]; then s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh"; elif [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" 'ruff.toml' '.ruff.toml' 'pyproject.toml' 'setup.cfg' '.editorconfig'; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Protect this stack's tooling config (ruff.toml;.ruff.toml;pyproject.toml;setup.cfg;.editorconfig) from being edited mid-run to make a diff pass. Denies only while an sdlc run state file is fresh and task_type is not chore; silent otherwise.

hooks.command: bash -c 's=""; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh" ]; then s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh"; elif [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" ruff check .; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Batched post-implement check: runs `ruff check .` once after this stack's architect finishes and relays failures to the orchestrator as a retry hint. Silent when the tool is absent or no run is active.
